quests.instruction: Which letter makes the ending sound in the word "DOG"?
quests.question: DOG
quests.hint: Say "DOG" slowly and listen for the very last sound you hear.
quests.explanation: "DOG" ends with the G sound -- say it slowly: DOG... G!
quests.funFact: Did you know? g is the 7th letter of the alphabet.

quests.instruction: Which letter makes the ending sound in the word "RED"?
quests.question: RED
quests.hint: Stretch out "RED"... which letter do you hear right at the end?
quests.explanation: Listen again: "RED" finishes with D. That is the ending sound!
quests.funFact: Did you know? in words like 'Wednesday', the D is practically silent.
